outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 4,451 women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy from 11 tertiary hospitals in China.
finding: FGR was associated with preterm birth, previous FGR history, abnormal Doppler results, and worse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including higher rates of HELLP syndrome, cesarean section, and neonatal morbidity.
birth_weight: Lower in the FGR group (1731.0 +/- 574.5 g) compared to the non-FGR group (2753.9 +/- 902.1 g)
